verdict.rationale: Deliverability monitoring is a fair axis for an email platform like Loops. Nothing in the evidence pack shows per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist reporting, or alerts and guidance when deliverability degrades. The closest items are domain setup docs, an unexplained 'Guardian checks on an email message' endpoint, and an agent skill for 'email sending best practices', and none of them describe post-send deliverability signals.
